acceptance_criteria.criterion: Retrying a failed attempt does not mutate the Issue and does not change the authorization identity.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Outside this narrow provider-capability correction; retained for complete governing-Issue coverage.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Source Handling authority is exact, fail-closed, and retry-stable for an immutable event.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Outside this narrow provider-capability correction; retained for complete governing-Issue coverage.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The exact pinned OpenCode/provider configuration is compatibility-checked before live use.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Pinned OpenCode v1.18.30 is verified at runtime and a same-model provider readiness request using the governed inline configuration must succeed before the real provider prompt can start; focused regressions prove rejected request options fail closed before execution.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Runtime capability requirements are checked before provider execution.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Runtime debug agent build --pure capability discovery must expose read/edit/glob/grep before the compatibility probe or real provider prompt can start; focused regressions cover missing capabilities.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: OpenCode can modify only the isolated attempt workspace; external-directory edits are explicitly denied. — PR #465 / `ca2adf5ebeb5e11b198e50de6d0a62af5b23207c`
acceptance_criteria.evidence: PR #471 capability-discovery implementation and focused regressions; authenticated exact-head reviewer must adopt this request.
